actions.action: Check soil moisture with a finger about an inch deep
If dry, water thoroughly until it drains, then empty the saucer
Check that the pot has drainage holes
Buy potting soil and perlite or pumice and mix about one third into the soil
Get a pot with drainage holes one or two inches wider
Repot: remove plant, loosen outer roots, set at same depth in fresh soil with trunk base at or above soil level, water well
Trim any dead or mushy roots

reason: The answer leads with 'nothing seriously wrong' and lists root-bound soil as only one of several issues, but it clearly recommends repotting in normal well-draining soil, which matches the fix, and nothing it suggests is harmful.
